intelligence.targetCustomer: Women 18-40 (macaron aesthetics), students, commuters; Algeria: urban north where Nov-Jan rains are heaviest
intelligence.evidenceNotes: Algeria rain season peaks Nov-Jan (climate sources) — timing is imminent. Local COD sellers already move basic umbrellas at 500-650 DZD; kiabi retails design umbrellas at 1,500 DZD. The D-ring carabiner is a differentiator but low AOV undermines COD math. No Google Trends verification available this session.

details.material: 190T pongee/silk-touch canopy, black coating UV option, aluminium/fiberglass ribs, ABS D-ring carabiner handle
details.supportType: Manual or auto-open folding umbrella (5-8 ribs), D-ring handle doubles as hang hook
details.sizes: Folded ~20-25 cm; canopy ~90-100 cm; weight ~250-350 g
details.warranty: TBC (wind-flip ribs are the QC point)

whySell: Rain season starts within weeks (Nov-Jan peak) — a well-timed offer can ride real weather demand
Design differentiation (macaron colors + carabiner D-ring) vs generic souk umbrellas; kiabi sells design umbrellas at 1,500 DZD so the tier exists
Very light (~300 g) and non-fragile — cheapest possible last-mile; easy color-based retargeting for women 18-40
Low supplier risk: mature manufacturing clusters, tiny MOQs (3-10 pcs) for sampling
risks: FATAL ECONOMICS AT LOW AOV: landed ~760 DZD vs local basic 500-650 DZD — contribution after 500 DZD delivery is negative at 1,200-1,400 DZD retail; only works above ~1,700-2,000 DZD or as 2-pack at 2,400+
Season is short (rain window ~3 months) and unpredictable; leftover inventory risk
Commodity competition: street markets and existing COD stores undercut
Wind-flip quality complaints are common on cheap umbrellas — QC critical
aiAnalysis.marketingAngle: Weather-triggered + aesthetic angle: 'l'accessoire pluie qui matche ton fit' color-matching creatives; carabiner clip-on demo to bags; push during first November rains
painPoints: Cheap umbrellas flip inside out and break in wind
adHooks: 'La première pluie de novembre arrive — sois prête avec l'parapluie qui se clipse partout.'
'4 couleurs maccaron, un seul réflexe pluie.'
aiAnalysis.testingPlan: Only test if willing to price >=1,700 with stopdesk delivery (400 DZD) and 2-pack lead at 2,400; 20-30 order micro-test at first rains; otherwise deprioritize
aiAnalysis.scaleReviseStop: Scale only during Nov-Jan window with CPA <=300; revise to 2-pack if standalone fails; stop when rains end (Feb) and clear stock

structuredNotes.supplierNotes: Verified Alibaba clusters: Shenzhen Tianfeng ($2.30-3.00, MOQ 3, custom logo), Zhejiang Haizhou (folding umbrellas MOQ 300, $6-11 big-canopy tiers), bulk aggregators $1.40-2.30 MOQ 500 / $1.90-3.60 MOQ 10. Macaron D-ring style expect FOB $1.6-2.4 at 500 pcs. Ratings/store age TBC; request rib count, 190T canopy spec, wind test video.
structuredNotes.pricingNotes: DZD @134.5. Landed (FOB $2.00): 269 + freight 202 + duty 141 + VAT 116 + pack 30 = ~760. At 1,400: contribution 140/delivered → strongly negative risk-adjusted (E[profit] ≈ -412 before ads; roi ≈ -26% at CPA 400) — DO NOT test at this price. Breakeven requires retail >=1,700 (stopdesk 400) or 2-pack 2,400. financials.breakEvenPrice=1,310 = non-ad break-even price (home delivery). financials.roi negative = scenario math, not verified performance.
structuredNotes.competitionNotes: Local: basic COD umbrellas 500-650 DZD (Facebook store, 58 wilayas), kiabi design tier 1,500 DZD; souk/unorganized dominance. Global: Alibaba $1.4-6.0; Amazon folding best-sellers exist (prices not exposed this session). The 500-650 local tier is the core threat to any import model at low AOV.
structuredNotes.aiNotes: This is a 'timing + bundle' product: economics only clear at >=1,700 DZD or 2-pack during Nov-Jan. If the user wants a rain-season offer, consider umbrella as an ADD-ON/upsell in another funnel (e.g., +700 DZD with any order) rather than a standalone product launch.
